title: RTEC employment-discrimination / historical Title VII complaint authority map

rules: Applicants and employees have the right to file complaints alleging discrimination.
Retaliation for filing a charge/complaint, participating in an employment-discrimination proceeding, or otherwise engaging in protected activity is prohibited.
The current EEO Officer is assigned day-to-day EEO program management, monitoring and complaint investigation and reports directly to the Executive Director.

historical_form_family.title: TITLE VII COMPLAINT FORM
fields: complainant contact information and accessible-format needs

historical_investigation_log_family.title: Title VII Investigations Form
historical_investigation_log_family.observed_2022_status: The June 30, 2022 AAP package reports no investigations, lawsuits or complaints in the historical log.
historical_investigation_log_family.privacy_rule: A blank/aggregate log is safe; any populated complaint/investigation log becomes restricted case evidence.

historical_procedure_context: Historical AAP text assigns tracking/investigation of complaints to the Executive Director or designee and provides internal management review/corrective-action steps.
Historical employee grievance language routes an employee first to the supervisor and then to the Executive Director if unresolved.
Historical forms/procedures should be preserved for chronology but do not supersede the current 2026 signed EEO policy or any later current complaint SOP.

terminology_quality_warning.finding: Some historical RTEC sources label a broad complaint procedure 'Title VII' while describing program/service discrimination concepts and bases that overlap multiple nondiscrimination authorities.
terminology_quality_warning.handling: Preserve the historical label exactly for provenance, but classify current cases by the governing current policy/process instead of assuming the old label accurately determines jurisdiction.

current_process_model: Receive an applicant/employee discrimination complaint through the current EEO reporting channel.
Store allegation, identity, witness and investigative details only in restricted case storage.
Confirm the governing complaint type/process and current investigating authority.
Acknowledge/intake the complaint under the current applicable procedure.
Gather relevant documents and interview appropriate parties/witnesses.
Document findings, corrective action or closure under the authorized current process.
Apply anti-retaliation protections and follow-up throughout the case lifecycle.
Maintain only non-identifying aggregate complaint metrics in generalized compliance reporting.
gaps: The current signed EEO policy does not itself supply a detailed complaint form, intake deadline, investigation target, appeal path or retention schedule.
No newer current RTEC-specific employment-discrimination complaint form/SOP has yet been established from the ingested corpus.
Historical Title VII forms should not be auto-published or used operationally until current adoption is confirmed.
